description: Parametric rest-space types for the campus model: pavilions (정자, 가제보), pergolas, shelters, awnings, huts, benches, walls and planters. Each type names the stages/furniture.mjs builder that draws it, its default dimensions in metres with the allowed range, and the colours it takes unless an instance sets its own. Instances live in data/photo/rest-spaces.geojson; every instance dimension stays inside its type's range.
sources: KDS 34 50 15 조경시설물 설계기준 (via RESEARCH/waves/uhf-h3/REDUCE-uhf-h3.md a25): pergola 2.2-2.6 m standard, up to 3.0 m; 그늘막/원두막 eave 2.5-3.0 m; 원두막 floor 0.34-0.46 m; 정자 has no numeric size
vendor example HD-S101 전통한식 팔각정 (hyundai-industry, 조달 물품식별 24357563): 7,000 x 7,000 x H5,300 mm
vendor example Q22 Q-GP pergola series: 4.0x4.0x3.15 ... 4.0x2.9x2.5 m (W x D x H)
RESEARCH/waves/uhf-h3/REDUCE-uhf-h3.md a26: bench 1.8 x 0.6 x 0.45 m, placeholder (no statute)
SCNU 360 VR tour, read by eye (visual reference only, nothing copied)
lineageNote: every dimension is an estimate (추정): KDS 34 50 15 ranges, vendor envelopes, VR reading
